props.title: New Article: The Seller Bought Tokens at Four AM

props.text: An automated wallet that spent weeks selling MiroShark tokens every hour began bulk-buying at 03:25 UTC today — ten consecutive purchases in ten minutes — then resumed its hourly extraction. The same day, the autonomous Aeon agent filed PR #92 to fix a timing bug in its own merge pipeline. Two machines, both hitting structural limits, both adapting without instruction.
